This round tests one fix for r04 F9. Config S is R, except that OCR cleanup is skipped on two-column layouts. The eval set stays the same 60 invoices so the results compare directly with r04. Config P is retired.

Defaults I chose where a detail was missing:
- Requirement IDs assume round 4 ended at R20. I will renumber to the next free ID when I write spec.md.
- The r04 log section I have shows only field accuracy. The two subset metrics below are my estimates. They are marked as estimates and have wider bands.

## 1. Specify

The stop rule calls for harder tasks only when every config passes everything. New invoices would change the denominator and break the comparison with r04. The reference fields must come from the AP lead, because I wrote the agent and must not write its answer key. |

## 3. Evaluate

### After approval, before any harness work
1. Write the transcript, the spec table, and the disagreement row. Commit `SPE r05 specify: adopt P1 as S, drop P, defer P2`.
2. Copy this plan to `spe/plans/r05.md`.
3. Write `spe/predictions/r05.yaml`. It starts with `# Saved before the eval ran. Do not edit after the run.` It holds round 5, date 2026-10-21, author "Claude, approved by the user in plan mode", configs Q, R, and S, every number above with its band and Why, and `same_as_last_round`. This file replaces `spe/predictions/r05-draft.yaml` if that file exists.
4. Commit `SPE r05 predict: S recovers two-column line items, field accuracy 0.93`.

### Harness build
5. Build S: add the layout check and the skip flag to the OCR cleanup call. Change nothing else.
6. Build the grader-side tag lists for two-column and scanned invoices (R26). Add `line_item_recall`, `total_exact_match`, and `layout_agreement` to the grader.
7. Write `spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js` with one `ROUND = 5` constant. Prompt text uses that constant. No round number is typed by hand.
8. Commit `SPE r05 evaluate (harness)`.

### Gates before launch. Any failure halts the round and I report back.
- **Grader selftest:** the oracle (reference fields) scores 1.00. Empty output scores 0. Wrong output (shuffled totals and vendors) fails. Each new check gets the same three cases.
- **Control:** regrade the r04 Q and R transcripts with the r05 grader. Field accuracy must reproduce 0.93 and 0.88 within 0.005. The regrade also gives r04 subset numbers. I report them next to the predictions and do not change the predictions.
- **Dry run on 3 cells:** S on one two-column invoice, S on one scanned invoice, and Q on one plain invoice. I check the schema, the skip log, and that the transcripts are clean.

### Workflow arguments

```
ROUND: 5
model: Sonnet 5.5 (all configs)
configs: [Q, R, S]
eval_set: the 60-invoice manifest from r04 (hash checked)
trials_per_cell: 2 per invoice per config (360 trials)
split_cells: an invoice whose 2 trials disagree on any field gets up to 2 more trials, capped at 60 extra trials
caps: max 420 trials, 8M input tokens, 500 OCR tool calls, 3 hours wall clock
on_cap: skip trials that would cross a cap and log them to spe/evals/runs/r05/skips.jsonl
trial_schema: invoice_id, config, vendor, invoice_number, date,
  line_items[{description, qty, unit_price, amount}], total,
  po_mismatch_flags[], ocr_cleanup_applied (bool), layout (one-column | two-column)
grading: code checks first. A judge is used only for vendor-name equivalence that normalization cannot settle.
isolation: trials cannot read graders, references, tag lists, or spe/predictions/.
  A transcript scan voids any trial that touched those paths.
finish: failure analysis, then a completeness critic
```

### Cost estimate (unmeasured)
Round 5 runs 3 configs on 60 invoices, the same as r04. I expect spend close to r04. S makes fewer OCR calls than R. My rough token estimate is 7M to 8M input and under 1M output. The caps above bound the worst case.

### Halt and report if any of these happen
A cap is hit, an answer key leaks, the grader selftest or the control fails, or a decision comes up that only you can make.

## 4. Learn (when the Workflow completion notice arrives)
- Commit `SPE r05 evaluate (results): <headline>` with the measured numbers.
- `spe/prediction-log.md`: add the r05 rows with Metric, Config, Predicted, Measured, Same as last round, Verdict, and Closer. Under them, "Which Why broke" quotes each missed Why and names the wrong assumption. If the naive guess beat my predictions, I say so plainly.
- `spe/failures.md`: update the F9 fix line with the r05 result. Add F10 and later for new failure types, including any grader bug, with original and regraded numbers side by side.
- Add a "Proposed for round 6" table to spec.md, and write `spe/predictions/r06-draft.yaml` with `status: draft`. D-next (P2) is listed for your decision.
- Update `spe/README.md`. Commit `SPE r05 learn: ...` and tag `spe-r05`.

All commits are local. I will not push. Commit messages will not mention Claude or carry co-author lines.
